# Gate 2.5 Trace Semantic Analysis

## Root Cause Of The Previous ~1800 Commits

The prior standalone fallback images ended with `jal x0,0` and had no working `tohost`, HTIF, ECALL, or custom halt detection. The runner stopped only at `--max-cycles 3000`. After BOOM boot code jumped from reset/boot ROM (`0x10040` region) into `0x80000000`, each program reached a self-loop and repeatedly retired the same `jal x0,0`. This produced about 1,800 additional commits. The old traces were therefore semantically truncated traces, not complete program reference traces.

The fallback programs were replaced with finite hand-encoded RV64I images that write `1` to configured `tohost` address `0x80000080`. Because the standalone memory path includes BOOM cache/store buffering, the runner now also detects a real retired store-to-tohost by decoding the committed store and using a small architectural register shadow derived only from earlier committed `rd_value`s. This is recorded as `tohost` event source `retired_store`.
